endpoint: Original August 2021 aboveground total dry biomass (g/m2) and signed NDE = B - original August 2021 CO2×N matched source monoculture expectation E

model.M0: intercept + richness9 indicator + N enrichment + 5 Ring fixed effects + directly native 14-species candidate log-SLA CWM
model.M1: M0 + equal-sown-weight 1D candidate log-SLA Rao-type pairwise distance
model.trait_subset_coverage: >=80% of sown species and >=2 native E141 candidate trait species
model.heldout: leave one complete originally sown composition vector out across ring/N
model.train_predictor_preprocessing: training-fold only CWM and FD standardization; no ring fixed effect with separately aliased CO2 dummy
model.source_yield_transforms: none: untransformed signed NDE and absolute B in g/m2
model.original_mono_expected_ratio: original 12 g/m2 seed evenly split among planted species; E=sum same-context mono means / S
model.training_weights: equal total weight per original CO2 ring

empirical_prediction.units: proportions, not raw percent: times100 for percentage points

interpretation.label: MODEL_SPECIFIC_NO_POSITIVE_FD_HELDOUT_PREDICTION_IN_SINGLE_SITE
interpretation.uncertainty_caveat: Fixed out-of-fold error ring bootstrap with six clusters, no model refit; mono and author derived trait uncertainty not fully propagated.
interpretation.original_EDI_source_caveat: Source native original EDI individual SLA dates not retrieved (HTTP403); author 2024 processed historical trait means and publication 1998-2020 date bound only.
interpretation.allocation_caveat: FD is derived from species compositions assigned in a one-site experiment; no separate FD intervention.
interpretation.source_scope: Secondary-derived retrospective one-year SLA subset, not 24-year causal or cross-experiment transport.
